# Copyright (c) 2024 Zephyr Project
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0

description: Generic pulse-counting flow meter sensor

compatible: "zephyr,flow-meter"

include: sensor-device.yaml

properties:
  pulse-gpios:
    type: phandle-array
    required: true
    description: |
      GPIO connected to the flow meter pulse output.

  power-gpios:
    type: phandle-array
    description: |
      Optional GPIO controlling power to the flow meter.

  pulses-per-liter:
    type: int
    required: true
    description: |
      Number of pulses generated per liter of fluid.
